title: Narrow warning policy comparison
scope: Design-only experiment; validator semantics and merge behavior are unchanged.
question: Can a warning policy reduce false-positive blocking without pretending that structural warnings prove truth?

method.labels: The baseline's fixed intent and classification labels; no consumer output changes them.

policies.warning_only: Allow every case while retaining warnings for review.
policies.block_overdue_recheck_only: Block only the overdue-recheck warning; treat all other warnings as review-only.

method.reproduction: Run the policy calculation twice over the same baseline and require byte-identical summaries.

finding.result: The overdue-only policy removes the two observed benign blocks from the naive gate, but still allows three adversarial cases.
finding.decision: Keep this as review-policy evidence, not an enforcement change. A safe merge gate needs independently labelled coverage for the remaining warning classes and false negatives.
finding.boundary: Neither policy establishes source truth, source independence, or production authorization safety.

next_step: Only test a stronger policy after adding fixed, independently labelled controls for the remaining warning classes; do not change validator semantics from this fixture.
